title: Late-Payment Interest Rate Schedule for Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claims
content:
An approval under a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan still unpaid after the level's payment issue period is paid as the outstanding approved amount plus late-payment interest. The late-payment interest is the outstanding approved amount multiplied by the late-payment rate and by the payment's late days, divided by 365.

## Late-payment rate

| Calendar days since the decision date | Late-payment rate (a year) |
| --- | --- |
| 71 or more | 0.18 |
| 41 to 70 | 0.12 |
| 11 to 40 | 0.06 |
| 10 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundaries

71 days take 0.18 and 70 take 0.12; 41 days take 0.12 and 40 take 0.06; 11 days take 0.06 and 10 take nothing. The days are counted from the decision date to the handling date, not from the assessment.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An outstanding approved amount of 1,460.00, 50 days since the decision and 38 late days: 1,460.00 multiplied by 0.12 and by 38, divided by 365, is 18.24 of late-payment interest.
